title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearly spiral-shelled snail who hums to herself and glides in slow pirouettes through a tank of moonlit teal water, trailing a ribbon of glowing plankton. Around her, a ring of mossy stones and swaying kelp make a small ballroom, and every few minutes she stops mid-twirl to listen, as though the water has just whispered something back.
